text_description: A cream and vivid red resort-like ensemble shown from upper torso to mid-leg, built in soft, relaxed layers: an open, hip-length cream cardigan or lightweight jacket sits over a matching collared knit top, with the outer layer edged and patterned in bold red horizontal bands, red shoulder patches, narrow black outlines, and small gold-tone buttons along the front edge. The overall palette is warm cream, saturated red, black accents, and gold jewelry, giving the look a polished nautical-resort or graphic knitwear mood.
